scope_summary: One Entra tenant and selected Azure subscription; creates or reconciles one prefixed application/service principal, one client secret, the reviewed thesis-demo-v2 custom role definition, and its subscription assignment.

permission_groups.scope: The selected subscription as the sole assignable scope of the generated thesis-demo-v2 custom role
Selected subscription and generated twin2mc-* service principal

credential_cleanup: Remove only the submitted client-secret key ID from the bootstrap application when Graph authority and ownership are proven.
Never delete or alter an existing_user_owned application credential.
Return manual_revocation_required when the safe key ID or Graph delete authority is unavailable.
limitations: Azure subscription Owner alone does not prove Entra application authority.
Application.ReadWrite.All is directory-wide and therefore a documented PoC bootstrap boundary, not formal least privilege.
Role-definition write/delete is privileged at the selected subscription; adapter ownership checks and a deterministic twin2mc-e2e-* role ID are mandatory before update or cleanup.
The exact custom-role, Graph, assignment, and cleanup behavior requires the separately approved setup-only live identity gate.
